sections.title: A team that knows *manufactured homes*

image.alt: The Aiken Housing Center staff on the porch of the sales office

body: Aiken Housing Center Superstore has helped families across Aiken, Augusta, North Augusta, Graniteville, Edgefield, Barnwell and the CSRA for over 40 years. Owner Scott Brinson and General Manager Earnest Lee lead a team with over 70 years of combined experience.

Sales Manager Coleman Brinson’s team will walk you through floor plans, land and financing, and after you buy, our construction team, led by Neil Arbaugh, manages delivery, setup and completion. One team, one process, done right from start to finish.

items.q: Do you sell land, or land and home packages?
items.a: Yes. We can put you on land we have, or find land in the area you want, and package it with your home and financing.
Almost anything: cars, old mobile homes, land, RVs. We’ll use it toward your down payment.

items.q: What’s the difference between modular and manufactured?
items.a: Manufactured homes have a permanent metal chassis and are built to the federal HUD Code. Modular homes sit on a permanent foundation and are built to the same local and state codes as a site-built home.

items.q: What credit score do I need?
items.a: We work with all credit types and have many financing programs, including FHA, VA and USDA. Call (803) 649-1603 to talk through your options.
We set a weekly payment that works for you and hold it in an account until you reach your down payment, then put you in the home you chose.
